summary: Draft NiO SCF calculation using collinear PBE with Ni-only Dudarev +U.
notes: All four initial moments follow the supplied Ni, O, Ni, O site order. No structure changes are planned.
Dudarev +U uses U−J = 4.5 eV on Ni; the requested U and J are preserved. Oxygen +U, SOC, hybrids and relaxation are excluded.
ISMEAR=0, SIGMA=0.05 eV and NELM=120 use supplied defaults. SAXIS=[0,0,1] is the convention without SOC or noncollinearity.
MAGMOM specifies initial seeds, not predicted moments or a proven ground state: https://www.vasp.at/wiki/index.php/MAGMOM
Requested cutoff and mesh are preserved; convergence remains unverified: https://www.vasp.at/wiki/index.php/ENCUT
No settings or results were copied from past runs. This is a draft for review, not a submission.
